Hi Kelsey —

Quick scope: NeonTech (our sponsor) wants serialized barcode labels on three promo SKUs (lanyard, insulated bottle, embroidered cap) and a split-case staging plan so venue receiving can scan-in by case at GrandHall. We need:

- Unique serial per unit (human-readable + Code128)
- Serial on unit and on inner box (matchable)
- Case-level label listing SKUs and serial ranges
- Packing list CSV with SKU / serial ranges for Atlas Logistics to pre-check

Quantities (final): lanyard 4,200; bottle 2,400; cap 3,000. Total units = 9,600.
Desired ship window to Atlas (DC in NJ) by 2026-09-26 latest so we have 48 hours to forward to GrandHall (delivery target 2026-09-28).

Please confirm: per-unit serialization cost, any per-run setup fee, lead time for printing + serialization, recommended label material for bottles (water-resistant), and whether you can produce the packing CSV and scan-sheet. I'm attaching the draft PO.

Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks — we can do full per-unit serialization and provide:

1) Serialized unit labels printed on weatherproof polyester for bottles (Code128 + human readable).
2) Inner-box labels that list the serial range and SKU.
3) Case labels with a compressed QR (links to CSV entry) and printed serial ranges.
4) Packing CSV and a pre-formatted scan-sheet for on-site receiving.

Costs/lead time (high level):
- Per-unit serialization add: $0.12/unit (applies to all units where label applied)
- One-time serialization setup / data formatting fee: $150
- Label material upcharge for bottles (waterproof): $0.03/unit for bottles only
- Lead time: 8 business days after final SKU files + approval of sample (we can turn on rush but adds 20% to price)

We can stage mixed-case configurations. We suggest limiting mixed-case to no more than 3 SKUs per case for faster scanning at GrandHall. If you prefer single-SKU inner boxes and mixed outer cases, we can do that — will include box content manifest per case.

I've attached the formal quote and a sample barcode layout for your ops team to validate. If you approve, we'll need the final PO and a CSV of unit serials (we can generate the serials if you prefer).

Best,
Kelsey Ramos
Sales Ops, SparkPrints
kelsey@sparkprints.co | +1 617-555-2364
